property_summary: For any admissible value v, SetMinSum(v) succeeds before initialization and sets MinSum to v, while a later SetMinSum after Initialized() reverts; the mutant's inverted reentrancy lock makes every SetMinSum revert, so MinSum never becomes v.
change_summary: Invert the reentrancy check so nonReentrant_ always reverts, making SetMinSum fail and leaving MinSum unchanged.
